defects.description: Pinned architecture and inactive H6 path are consistent with native-logit common evidence.
defects.implemented_rule: H6 is enabled in metadata but h6_patch_logits is not supplied to Phase2B predictor.
defects.preregistered_rule: H6 must be disabled/inactive or native evidence is foundationally mismatched.

defects.description: Static formulas, source paths, and pure synthetic contracts match frozen protocol.
gt_read status is set true only after successful evaluate; a later crash could under-report GT access.
defects.implemented_rule: main() updates gt_read only on evaluate() success.
defects.preregistered_rule: Separate metadata, mask-pixel, and metric first-read provenance.
defects.result_impact: none for the historical pre-mask crash; reporting risk for a different crash point.

defects.description: config_sensitivity rewards selected-config within-class mean-minus-median rather than cross-config robustness.
defects.implemented_rule: best selected-config class mean minus its class median.
defects.preregistered_rule: Research score config sensitivity should measure stability across configs.
defects.result_impact: research interpretation only; no scientific gates or eligibility.

defects.description: R_neg best-config direction is selected by maximum mean rather than safest most-negative mean.
defects.implemented_rule: max(means) used for all sensitivity metrics.

defects.description: Pre-GT sources do not unambiguously define ordinal rank-normalization versus raw-margin min-max normalization; ordinal sensitivity changes CSRC FOLD_1 and ASR FOLD_2.
defects.historical_artifact_affected: FOLD_SELECTIONS.json and all downstream historical OOF outputs
defects.implemented_rule: Historical evaluator and checker use min-max raw margins.
defects.preregistered_rule: Source hierarchy requires an unambiguous pre-GT rule before deterministic correction.
defects.result_impact: scientific OOF selection and class-level metrics are interpretation-dependent.

defects.description: Historical checker repeats the historical selection interpretation and therefore cannot independently detect the semantic ambiguity.
defects.preregistered_rule: Independent checker must reconstruct against frozen semantics.
defects.result_impact: checker coverage gap; no new numerical claim.
